About

I’m an AI/ML & Data Science Trainer currently working with Alliance University, Bengaluru through FACE Prep, delivering industry-oriented technical and employability training to students.

My training areas include Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, Generative AI, data analysis, model building and the practical implementation of AI/ML concepts. I love simplifying complex ideas and connecting theory with hands-on projects, exercises and real-world applications.

Alongside tech, I have a strong background in English communication, business communication, interview preparation, soft skills and personality development, so I work at the intersection of technology and effective communication.

I’m especially interested in Generative AI, RAG, AI applications and practical AI/ML education. My goal is to contribute to technology education and industry-focused learning while growing in AI, ML, Data Science and emerging GenAI.
